name: com.yildizoguzhan.ai-driven-npcs
description: Modular, prefab-based local AI NPC system. Integrates LLM (LLMUnity), speech recognition (Whisper) and TTS (PiperTTS). Drag and drop [AI System] + [NPC] prefabs into your scene. No cross-Inspector wiring needed.

samples.description: Modular AI-NPC system. Includes: AISystemManager, ChatUIController, VoiceInputService (Whisper STT), VoiceOutputService (PiperTTS + TextMeshPro), ModelBootstrapper, NPCAgent, AIOScene demo scene, and all prefabs (AISystem, LLM, NPC, Player, TTS). TMP Essential Resources are imported automatically.
